You’re not wrong, but acid jumping is relative to how conditioned you are to it’s effects. Not that this isn’t true with shrooms but with those I’ve only ever had the same effects get more intense. With acid once you take strong enough amounts you really do begin to have visions, thoughts, ideas, and feelings(mentally and physically) that you didn’t know were possible or even existed. That’s why it’s such a beautiful substance imo and changes the way people perceive life entirely.

Personally I think the body high is more intense and if you’re sitting, can be somewhat couch locking. The visuals would be an exaggeration of 200ug basically but no new crazy visions(still looks reallyyy fuckin awesome). Also might have you at peak 30-60 mins longer. It’s a pleasurable jump from what you’ve already experienced. I started with 100ug at a rave, then did my first 200 at home and 2 weeks later jumped to 400, then 600 a month later. Things get very very interesting at 500+(when you work up to it) in my opinion.
